parameters.query:
-- TODO Yash: replace with actual brain table + recent-blog SELECT.
-- Pulls last 30 days of published Sanity blog titles + industries so Marketa
-- avoids re-pitching the same angle. Also pulls top competitor topic gaps
-- if you have that table; otherwise drop the UNION.
SELECT title, metadata->>'industry' AS industry, created_at
FROM {{ SUPABASE_BRAIN_TABLE }}
WHERE source_type = 'sanity'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
